qualificationRule: Metadata completeness and runtime qualification are independent. Catalog presence, source-matrix text, candidate formulas, legacy prototypes, or old package benchmarks never pass a runtime gate.

globalRealtimeRequirements.browserQuantumFrames: read from actual AudioWorklet output buffers at runtime; never assume 128

pitchEvaluationRequirements.rubberBandEvaluation: Evaluate R2 and R3 independently; pin exact version, license and distribution mode before adopting. License approval is a hard gate, not a benchmark result.

hardwareEvidence.currentAuditScope: software/build/unit-test evidence only; no hardware end-to-end acceptance
hardwareEvidence.qualificationRule: A software-only run may qualify only the stated software scope. Hardware/device claims require a named hardware run and evidence.
